title: SitPose: Real-Time Detection of Sitting Posture and Sedentary Behavior Using Ensemble Learning With Depth Sensor

extractionLocations.section: Sections 3-5; sensor, joint-selection, and participant descriptions
extractionLocations.description: The study uses Azure Kinect 3D joints from 36 participants to classify sitting postures; it provides design context but not RGB webcam shoulder-line validation.
